title: Pasta with Tomato Sauce
description: Demonstrates parallel sections — the sauce and the pasta run side by side, then converge.

steps.title: Sweat garlic
steps.body: Mince {{ garlic.name }}. Heat {{ olive_oil }} in a saucepan over medium-low heat, add the garlic, and cook 1 minute until fragrant — don't let it brown.

steps.title: Simmer tomatoes
steps.body: Add {{ tomatoes }} and a pinch of {{ salt.name }}. Simmer for @timer(15m), stirring occasionally.

steps.title: Boil pasta water
steps.body: Bring a large pot of water with {{ salt }} to a rolling boil.

steps.title: Cook spaghetti
steps.body: Add {{ pasta }} and cook al dente, ~@timer(9m). Reserve a cup of pasta water before draining.

steps.title: Combine
steps.body: Toss the drained pasta with the sauce, loosening with pasta water as needed. Tear in {{ basil }} leaves.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Plate up and top with {{ parmesan }}.
